verdict: Organic presence is active; paid channels and pipeline blockers need resolution.
narrative: Across all three entities this period, your Google Business Profile listings generated 389 combined actions — directions, calls, and website clicks — with O'Hare Precision Metals showing a healthy +24% week-over-week lift and search clicks trending up across the group. The end-of-week drop in GBP engagement at Forte and Advance Grinding (down 80% and 72% respectively over the last 7 days) reflects softening local search visibility and is being addressed through site reindexing and SEO fixes already in motion. No paid spend ran on Meta or Google Ads for any entity this period, meaning all measurable activity is organic and inbound leads from paid channels remain at zero. Outreach sequences, CRM reconciliation, and the web root-cause fixes are now in active execution, which positions next period to begin capturing the search intent that is currently going unanswered. Expect GBP stability to return as reindexing completes and the first outreach waves go live.
